icon_directions.name: Fold
icon_directions.description: Rounded ivory paper slip, single gold folded corner, one ink line.

icon_directions.name: Peek
icon_directions.description: Ivory note with a small golden tab at its right edge; the clearest reference to the side-notch interaction.

icon_directions.name: Curl
icon_directions.description: A broad golden paper curl with an ivory underside; the most distinctive symbol for an unfurling panel.
